title: Transaction row (Source A or Source B)

row_id.description: Unique within a case; prefix A or B identifies the source.

reference.description: Merchant/partner reference; may be messy (casing, truncation, prefixes).

fx_rate.description: Rate applied when the row is a conversion of a foreign-currency amount; null otherwise.

net_amount.description: gross_amount - fee_amount; generator guarantees consistency for clean rows.

foreign_currency.description: Original currency when the row books a converted amount; null otherwise.

foreign_amount.description: Amount in foreign_currency. Convention: gross_amount = round(foreign_amount * fx_rate, 2).
